step1_analysis.description: A common-emitter RF power amplifier (Q2) featuring an active input clamping circuit (Q1, R1, R2). The feedback clamp attenuates the input RF signal during overvoltage conditions to protect the amplifier from load-mismatch-induced breakdown (VSWR protection).

paper_reference.title: A VSWR-Protected Silicon Bipolar RF Power Amplifier With Soft-Slope Power Control

Voltage_Gain.description: Small-signal voltage gain from input to output

paper_reported.value: 80 dB (Note: likely refers to total system gain, single stage is lower)

sky130_expected.calculation: Gain = gm * Rload. For Ic=16mA, gm ~ 600mS. With Rload=200 ohm, intrinsic gain is high but limited by Early voltage and parasitics. Expected ~15-20 dB.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Based on a standard common-emitter amplifier stage with a 200 ohm load.

sky130_expected.calculation: BW = 1 / (2 * pi * Rload * C_out). Assuming C_out ~ 50fF and Rload = 200 ohm -> BW ~ 15 GHz.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Bandwidth is heavily dependent on the load capacitance and resistance.

Output_Power.description: Maximum RF output power before significant compression

sky130_expected.calculation: Pout = Vrms^2 / Rload. For 1.8V supply, max peak swing is ~1.5V. Pout = (1.5/sqrt(2))^2 / 50 = 22.5 mW = 13.5 dBm.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Limited by the 1.8V supply voltage in standard CMOS/BiCMOS processes compared to higher voltage bipolar processes.

DC_Power.description: DC power consumption of the amplifier stage

sky130_expected.calculation: Power = VDD * Ic. VDD=1.8V, Ic=16mA -> Power = 28.8 mW.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Typical power for a pre-amplifier or low-power PA driver stage.

step3_testbench.description: Testbench for VSWR-Protected RF PA measuring DC power, AC gain, bandwidth, and transient response.
step3_testbench.spice:
* VSWR-Protected RF PA Testbench
.lib "${SKY130_PDK}" tt

.param R1_val=10k
.param R2_val=10k

* DUT
R1 RFin N1 {R1_val}
R2 N1 GND {R2_val}
Q1 RFin N1 GND npn
Q2 RFout RFin GND npn

* Generic NPN model for simulation (since netlist specifies npn)
.model npn npn(is=1e-16 bf=100 vaf=50 cje=100f cjc=50f)

* Biasing and Load
VDD VDD 0 DC 1.8
Rload VDD RFout 200

* Input Bias Tee
Vbias RFin_DC 0 DC 0.85
L1 RFin_DC RFin 1m
Vac RFin_AC 0 DC 0 AC 1 sin(0 0.1 1.8G)
C1 RFin_AC RFin 1u

.control
* DC Analysis
op
let pwr = -i(VDD)*1.8
print pwr

* AC Analysis
ac dec 50 100Meg 10G
let gain_db = vdb(RFout) - vdb(RFin)
meas ac max_gain max gain_db
meas ac bw_3db when gain_db=(max_gain-3) fall=1

* Transient Analysis
tran 10p 5n
meas tran vout_pp pp v(RFout)
meas tran vin_pp pp v(RFin)
let tran_gain = vout_pp / vin_pp
print tran_gain

quit
.endc
